name: Datum Calc
tagline: Engineering calculations with real units, as readable maths, with checks and a printable calc sheet.
for: Mechanical, process, structural and electrical engineers, students and lecturers: everyone who writes calculations.
about: Datum Calc is a desktop app for engineering calculation sheets. You type equations with their units, such as Q = 120 m^3/h or P = rho*g*Q*H/eta; Datum Calc shows them as readable maths, works out each answer with its unit, and catches mistakes such as adding metres to seconds on the line where they happen.

Checks compare results with their limits and show PASS or FAIL with the utilisation. The sheet prints as a clean, referenced calc sheet with a title block (project, calc number, by, checked, date, revision) and page numbers, ready to hand in. Ready-made calc packs for pumps, pipes, compressors, heat exchangers, tanks, pipe walls, pipe insulation, vessels, beams, columns, shafts, bolts, welds, thermal expansion, motors, cables, AC circuits and filters start you off. Water, steam and gas properties are built in, and complex numbers (3 + 4j) work out AC circuits, shown as 3 + 4j or as magnitude and angle.

steps.title: Write the equations
steps.text: Type each equation with its units, top to bottom, as on paper; the maths is shown as you would write it.

steps.title: Check the results
steps.text: Every answer carries its unit; checks against your limits show PASS or FAIL with the utilisation ratio.

steps.title: Print the calc sheet
steps.text: Fill in the title block and print or save a PDF with page numbers and references.

highlights: Equations with real units: about 200 units, SI with prefixes and US customary, absolute and difference temperatures, torques in N·m, angular frequencies in rad/s, any result in any unit of its kind, dimension errors caught on the line.
Readable maths: what is shown is drawn from the same expression the engine computes.
Checks with PASS or FAIL and the utilisation ratio.
Solve for the value that makes an equation zero within a range, plot functions such as a pump curve against the system curve, and tables with units per column.
Solve one equation in a range, or several equations together for several unknowns, with units.
Vectors and matrices with units: a stiffness matrix in kN/m and loads in kN give displacements in m; multiply, transpose, inverse, determinant and linear systems.
Small programs in a region: if, else, for, while and break with units, or a function that returns a value, such as a friction factor for any flow regime.
Water and steam properties by IAPWS-IF97, and air and common gases, as functions with units: water_h(400 °C, 40 bar), water_x(0.1 bar, h), gas_cp(air, T).
Data in and curve fitting: paste cells from a spreadsheet or read a CSV file into a table, fit a model to it by least squares with units, and plot the curve with the measured points.
Differential equations with units: ode x'' = -k/m*x for t in 0 .. 10 s from x = 1 cm, x' = 0 solves in time, plots the result and makes x(t) available below.
Your own units (unit bbl_oil = 158.987 L), templates of your own sheets, and your company's title block for every new sheet.
Thirty ready calc packs, each with its reference and a test against a worked example.
Complex numbers for AC circuits in the frequency domain: impedances such as (8 + 9.42j) Ω, phasors as 230 V∠-30°, impedances in parallel, complex power, and Bode plots on a log frequency axis.
Each equation can be shown again with its numbers put in, as on a hand calculation.
Exact maths: fractions that stay fractions, and simplify, expand and factor on expressions.
About 250 materials from Datum Atlas: pick one and its density, moduli, strengths and thermal properties become names with units, with their sources.
A printable calc sheet with a title block, a summary of checks, page numbers and references; inputs and results export as CSV.
